paragraphs.text: The Harmony of the Gospels, Book II
Chapter 59. Of the Occasion on Which the Disciples Were Exceeding Sorry When He Spoke to Them of His Passion, as It is Related in the Same Order by the Three Evangelists.

117. Matthew continues thus: <quote>And while they abode in Galilee, Jesus said unto them, The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men; and they shall kill Him, and the third day He shall rise again. And they were exceeding sorry.</quote> Mark and Luke record this passage in the same order.

latex.p0002: 第五十九章　论\Person{耶稣}向门徒谈论祂的苦难时，门徒极其忧伤的场合，三位福音作者以相同顺序记载此事。
latex.p0003: 117. \Person{玛窦}接着这样记载：\Quote{他们住在\Place{加里肋亚}时，\Person{耶稣}对他们说：\InnerQuote{人子将被交在人手中，他们要杀害祂，第三日祂必要复活。}他们便极其忧伤。}\Person{马尔谷}和\Person{路加}也以相同顺序记载了这段话。
